principle: Geographic aliases and hierarchies are modeled separately from tariff fare identities. Reviewed local geography may normalize search/display names, but it may select a fare only when the normalized place maps unambiguously to the applicable published tariff endpoint; otherwise quoting fails closed.

sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.label: Charlotte Amalie
sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.reason: Reviewed local geography: Town/Downtown refers collectively to the three quarters of Charlotte Amalie. These are geographic aliases for the city context, not a license to collapse separately published tariff endpoints located within town.

sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.label: Lindbergh Bay Estate
sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.reason: Reviewed local geography: Lindbergh refers to the estate; Lindberg Bay refers to the beach; the official surrounding area is Lindbergh Bay Estate. These geographic relationships do not make the estate or beach synonymous with Airport Terminal for fare selection.

sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.label: Airport Terminal
sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.reason: Airport Terminal remains the exact published fare endpoint. A location merely within Lindbergh Bay Estate does not resolve to Airport Terminal unless the traveler specifically selects the airport/terminal.

sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.label: Dorothea / Dorothea Estate
sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.reason: Reviewed local geography: Dorothea and Dorothea Estate refer to the same estate, comprised of Lower Dorothea and Upper Dorothea. Published tariff rows remain distinct where their fares differ; geographic equivalence cannot erase those fare-zone distinctions.

sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.label: Havensight
sourceBackedCanonicalNotes.reason: Published tariff identities distinguish Havensight (crossroad) and Havensight (WICO); generic Havensight remains financially ambiguous.

Charlotte Amalie.fareSelectionRule: Town/Downtown may normalize to Charlotte Amalie when the tariff endpoint sought is the city itself. Do not use the alias to override a more specific published endpoint within Charlotte Amalie.

Lindbergh Bay Estate.fareSelectionRule: Lindbergh or Lindbergh Bay Estate identifies the estate/area, Lindberg Bay identifies the beach, and Airport Terminal identifies the airport fare endpoint. Never convert estate/beach input to Airport Terminal merely by containment.

Dorothea Estate.fareSelectionRule: Exact Lower/Upper input selects that subzone. Otherwise retain an exact broad Dorothea source row when that route publishes it, or require clarification when multiple published rows could apply.

completionInterpretation: Canonical endpoint audit is complete when reviewed geographic aliases/hierarchies are represented accurately, all published tariff endpoints remain addressable, containment cannot manufacture an airport or subzone fare, and genuinely ambiguous labels still fail closed.
